newsitem.headline: MDU Resources Group Inc Q3 net down.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1996 earnings per share before preferred dividends $0.30 vs $0.37.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month 1996 earnings per share before preferred dividends $1.06 vs $1.03.

Nine-month 1996 results include $3.7 million or $0.13 a share net charge, reflecting write down to current market price of natural gas available under a repurchase commitment and the reversal of certain reserves for tax and other contingencies. Excluding the charge, nine-month 1996 earnings from ongoing operations were $33.4 million or $1.17 a share.
